rec.name: PDP UGC Customer Photo Carousel (Product Block)

what.text: A product-page block that shows a swipeable carousel of 1–5 customer photo cards (UGC). Each card has a rounded thumbnail with a dark gradient at the bottom. Over the gradient sit a round reviewer avatar, a star rating, the reviewer name (e.g. "Jennifer M.") and a smaller time label (e.g. "Vor 3 Monaten"). An optional centered headline sits above the carousel ("Das sagen unsere Kund*innen"). The block can render as a normal block or inside a collapsible accordion (the screenshot shows it under a "Rückgabe" collapsible, next to the add-to-cart button). Content is stored per product in a metaobject, which is referenced by a product metafield.

why.text: Real customer photos in a real setting are credible social proof. They show the product in use and reduce purchase uncertainty. Placing them next to the add-to-cart button puts the proof at the decision point. Name, star rating and recency ("3 months ago") make the reviews feel authentic. The swipeable carousel keeps the block compact on mobile and invites interaction.

how.text: 1) Create the metaobject definition "CRO | UGC Section" (type cro_ugc_section). Fields: name, collapsible/button title, feedback title, and for each of 5 slots a thumbnail (file), avatar (file), rating (number), name (text) and label (text). 2) Create a product metafield "CRO | UGC Section" as a Mixed reference limited to that metaobject, with Storefront API access enabled. 3) In the product section's {% schema %}, add the block "CRO | UGC Section" (type cro_ugc_section, limit 1) to the blocks[] array, inside the brackets and with a comma if it follows another block. 4) Create the snippet cro_ugc_section.liquid. It reads the product metafield, outputs scoped CSS from the block settings, builds a Flickity config, loops over slots 1–5 and renders only slots that have a thumbnail. It wraps the content in a collapsible when layout = collapsible. 5) Render the snippet from the product section's block loop. 6) For each product, create a metaobject entry, upload the photos and avatars, and assign it to the product. Ticket note: the instructions had to be rewritten step by step so non-developers can follow them regardless of theme (not every theme has main-product.liquid), and a setup video exists.

items: Collapsible title size, border color, arrow color, arrow background
Heading size (desktop and mobile) and alignment (left/center/right)
Carousel: autoplay, draggable, infinite loop, cell-align (left/center)
Page dots on/off and dots color
Visible item width (10–100%) and gap between cards (0–30px)
Card aspect ratio: Square / Classic (3:2) / Widescreen (16:9)
Rating star color and text color

dependencies.text: Product metafield standard.cro_ugc_section (Mixed reference) pointing to the metaobject cro_ugc_section with Storefront API access. Theme needs a product section with a blocks[] schema and the <flickity-carousel> custom element (Flickity). The theme is assumed to provide the collapsible markup and CSS classes, and a global empty-star color setting (settings.feedback_empty_rating_color). The code sample reads product.metafields.standard.cro_pdp_ugc_section, while the documented key is cro_ugc_section. The two should be aligned. Final build removed the Figma example's extra header (price comparison) and footer (image + text) fields. The metaobject screenshot still shows those fields.

items: PDP conversion rate (add-to-cart rate and purchase CVR)
Collapsible open rate (if collapsible layout is used)
